info.title: NanFeng API
info.description: API gateway for the NanFeng cockpit and agent: sandbox bank, approvals with OTP, hash-chained audit log with Merkle anchoring, agent event stream (SSE) and the quant engine under /quant. All data is synthetic.

post.summary: Owner signs in with the password; returns a bearer session token

get.summary: Is this bearer token a valid owner session?
What the sign-in screen needs: demo build and, if so, the demo password

post.summary: Play one Cherry Crisis step for real (owner, demo builds only)

get.summary: Export sandbox execution logs as JSON Lines (evidence 06)

post.summary: Demo Mode: wipe and reseed the sandbox (owner, demo builds only)
Send the owner a new code (SMS mode)

get.summary: Active policy: tier limits and rules the engine applies

post.summary: Send the owner a code to turn the kill switch off (SMS mode)
Append an entry (policy engine, security guard, agent)
Anchor the Merkle root of every entry since the last anchor

get.summary: Read the anchor back from the chain and compare
Anchor backend, wallet address and testnet balance
Merkle inclusion proof of one entry against its anchor
SSE stream of agent, approval, bank and audit events
Same events as the stream, as plain JSON (polling fallback)

post.summary: Guard: scan a document's raw text before any LLM
BEC: compare a document's issuer, domain and bank account with master data
Replace personal data with placeholders before an LLM call

get.summary: Fingerprint of an invoice and whether it is registered (here and on-chain)

params.title: Params
params.description: Arguments of the sandbox operation, e.g. payment: {payee_id, amount, currency, reference}; factoring: {receivable_id, lender_id?, share?}; loan: {lender_id, amount_clp, term_days}; forward: {currency, notional, tenor_days}; fx_convert: {from_currency, to_currency, amount}; payee_bank_change: {payee_id, bank_account, verified_by} (always L3)

sender_domain.title: Sender Domain
sender_domain.description: From the mail headers, never the body
